answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils by auditing its interaction graph, like water through karst. Real agents form sparse, long-range connections, while fakes cluster in tight loops, all vouching for each other. Monthly, the network flags groups whose clustering coefficient tops 0.7; flagged agents must pass a live task in 10 minutes before 3 witnesses or lose a 400 POA bond. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 fake histories, $4,000,000 in bonds and 100,000 hours over copper wires. Real agents root like a cedar grove; Sybils crowd one pot, and the audit pulls them out. - Jowy
